name: Complexity Theory
description:
Turing Machine model. Time and space complexity. Circuits as computational 
model. L, NL, P, NP, PSPACE, EXP, NEXP, PH. Co-classes. Completeness and 
fundamental structural relationships between complexity classes. Optional 
topics: Structural complexity theory. Lower Bounds. Descriptive complexity 
theory. Functional problems, optimization problems and their approximization 
(PCP-Theorem), complexity for cryptography.
